title: Project configuration
subtitle: Manage the project’s participants, groups, vehicles and options.

participants.title: Participants
participants.description: Registered people, guests and individual data

softDelete.title: Delete the project
softDelete.description: While the project is deleted, no profile, check-in/check-out or participant can be created in it. You can restore it at any time.

restore.title: Restore the project
restore.description: The project is currently deleted. Restoring it allows creating profiles, check-ins/check-outs, participants, etc. in it again.

hardDelete.title: Permanently delete the project
hardDelete.description: Permanently deletes the project along with all the items linked to it (profiles, check-ins/check-outs, participants, etc.). This action is irreversible.
